title: Functional Adjoint Sampler: Scalable Sampling on Infinite Dimensional Spaces
abstract: arXiv:2511.06239v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Learning-based methods for sampling from the Gibbs distribution in finite-dimensional spaces have progressed quickly, yet theory and algorithmic design for infinite-dimensional function spaces remain limited. This gap persists despite their strong potential for sampling the paths of conditional diffusion processes, enabling efficient simulation of trajectories of diffusion processes that respect rare events or boundary constraints. In this work, we present the adjoint sampler for infinite-dimensional function spaces, a stochastic optimal control-based diffusion sampler that operates in function space and targets Gibbs-type distributions on infinite-dimensional Hilbert spaces. Our Functional Adjoint Sampler (FAS) generalizes Adjoint Sampling (Havens et al., 2025) to Hilbert spaces based on a SOC theory called stochastic maximum principle, yielding a simple and scalable matching-type objective for a functional representation. translated_title: 函数伴随采样器：无限维空间上的可扩展采样
translated_abstract: arXiv:2511.06239v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：基于学习的有限维空间中吉布斯分布采样方法进展迅速，但无限维函数空间的理论和算法设计仍然有限。尽管这些方法在采样条件扩散过程路径方面具有巨大潜力，能够高效模拟尊重罕见事件或边界约束的扩散过程轨迹，但这一差距依然存在。在本工作中，我们提出了无限维函数空间的伴随采样器，这是一种基于随机最优控制的扩散采样器，在函数空间中运行，并针对无限维希尔伯特空间上的吉布斯型分布。我们的函数伴随采样器（FAS）基于称为随机最大值原理的SOC理论，将伴随采样（Havens等人，2025年）推广到希尔伯特空间，从而为函数表示产生一个简单且可扩展的匹配型目标。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为函数伴随采样器（FAS）的新方法，将随机最优控制理论应用于无限维希尔伯特空间，实现了对吉布斯型分布的高效可扩展采样，并显著简化了匹配目标的计算。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Functional Adjoint Sampler (FAS), a novel method that applies stochastic optimal control theory to infinite-dimensional Hilbert spaces, enabling efficient and scalable sampling of Gibbs-type distributions with a simplified matching objective.
